question: (x − y) (x + y) (x2 + y2) (x⁴ + y4) is equal to :
solution:
**Given:**

(x - y) (x + y) (x² + y²) (x⁴ + y⁴) is equal to:

**Formula used:**

(x - y) (x + y) = x² - y²

**Calculation:**

(x - y) (x + y) (x² + y²) (x⁴ + y⁴)

⇒ (x² - y²) (x² + y²) (x⁴ + y⁴) ...........(Combining (x2 - y2) (x2 + y2) )

⇒ (x⁴ - y⁴) (x⁴ + y⁴) ...........(Combining (x4 - y4) (x4 + y4) )

⇒ (x⁸ - y⁸)

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
